AbstractCheck.description: Abstract vs. body. Only overclaims or contradictions count as inconsistent; scope the abstract leaves out is listed separately and not flagged as a warning.

overclaims.description: Overclaims or contradictions: claims in the abstract the body does not support, or numbers and conclusions that do not match the body. For each, state what the abstract says and what the body actually shows, with page numbers such as [p.6]; leave empty if none

scope_gaps.description: Scope left out: the body supports the abstract's claim, but only under narrower conditions (e.g. only some models tested, a very small sample, a single dataset) that the abstract does not mention. State the condition for each, with page numbers; leave empty if none
scope_gaps.title: Scope Gaps
